ti_buffer_transient.scope: single TI active-high channel, 3.3 V, 30 pF and 10 kohm load, default ngspice temperature; functional pulse and enable/release checks

ti_buffer_package.scope: authored eight-port logical review wrapper using two unchanged vendor active-high stages and ideal algebraic TX-enable inversion; fixed 3.3 V, enables within 0..VCC; DC logic/high-Z functional tests with fixed-voltage CPU/bus mocks
ti_buffer_package.placed_r6_value: 0R; ideal zero-volt link keeps DXL_DATA/DXL_BUS boundary
limitations: No eight-pin TI-qualified analog model is claimed.
Ideal inverter isolates physical DE input from vendor enable capacitance/impedance; no physical inversion delay.
VCC-DE becomes negative for DE>VCC; power-off/back-drive/overvoltage cases are outside this wrapper scope.
Two channel power models do not qualify shared package ICC.
Test pull loads are fixture values, not measured MCU/harness parasitics.
